types.SM.wall_epsilons_one_or_neg_one:
SM.wall_epsilons_one_or_neg_one (x y z : ℝ) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x) :

types.SM.collinear_left_gate_sign:
SM.collinear_left_gate_sign (a b c r : SM.Plane) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0) (h : b - a = s • (c - a)) :
  SM.pointFarSign a r c = SignType.sign s * SM.pointFarSign a r b
types.SM.collinear_right_gate_sign:
SM.collinear_right_gate_sign (a b c r : SM.Plane) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0) (h : b - c = s • (a - c)) :

SM.affine_collinear_left_gate (p ω r : SM.Plane) (x y z : ℝ) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzx : z ≠ x) :

types.SM.affine_collinear_right_gate:
SM.affine_collinear_right_gate (p ω r : SM.Plane) (x y z : ℝ) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x) :

types.SM.geometricBoundaryArray_pointFarSign:
SM.geometricBoundaryArray_pointFarSign.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) :
  SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g t =
    ↑↑(SM.pointFarSign (SM.boundaryWord P g t.lower) (SM.boundaryWord P g t.middle) (SM.boundaryWord P g t.upper))
types.SM.boundary_collinear_left_sign:
SM.boundary_collinear_left_sign.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (p ω : SM.Plane) (x y z : ℝ)
  (hx : SM.boundaryWord P g t.lower = p + x • ω) (hy : SM.boundaryWord P g t.middle = p + y • ω)
  (hz : SM.boundaryWord P g t.upper = p + z • ω) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzx : z ≠ x) (r : Fin n) (hl : t.lower < r)
  (hr : r < t.middle) :
  SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g
      { lower := t.lower, middle := r, upper := t.upper, lower_middle := hl, middle_upper := ⋯ } =
    ↑↑(SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z) *
      SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g
        { lower := t.lower, middle := r, upper := t.middle, lower_middle := hl, middle_upper := hr }
types.SM.boundary_collinear_right_sign:
SM.boundary_collinear_right_sign.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (p ω : SM.Plane) (x y z : ℝ)
  (hx : SM.boundaryWord P g t.lower = p + x • ω) (hy : SM.boundaryWord P g t.middle = p + y • ω)
  (hz : SM.boundaryWord P g t.upper = p + z • ω) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x) (r : Fin n) (hl : t.middle < r)
  (hr : r < t.upper) :
  SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g
      { lower := t.lower, middle := r, upper := t.upper, lower_middle := ⋯, middle_upper := hr } =
    ↑↑(SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z) *
      SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g
        { lower := t.middle, middle := r, upper := t.upper, lower_middle := hl, middle_upper := hr }

types.SM.WallGerm.boundary_values_stable_near_:
SM.WallGerm.boundary_values_stable_near_center.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (w : SM.WallGerm n) (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (hZ : SM.pointZeroTriples w.center = {SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet g t}) :
  ∃ δ,
    0 < δ ∧
      δ ≤ w.radius ∧
        ∀ (s : ↑w.Parameter),
          |↑s| < δ →
            (∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n),
                u ≠ t → SM.geometricBoundaryArray (w.curve s) g u = SM.geometricBoundaryArray w.center g u) ∧
              (∀ (J : SM.BoundaryInterval n),
                  ¬(J.left ≤ t.lower ∧ t.upper ≤ J.right) →
                    SM.farOnlyCoordinates (SM.geometricBoundaryArray (w.curve s) g) J =
                      SM.farOnlyCoordinates (SM.geometricBoundaryArray w.center g) J) ∧
                ∀ (J : SM.BoundaryInterval n),
                  ¬(J.left ≤ t.lower ∧ t.upper ≤ J.right) →
                    SM.farOnlyOutput (SM.geometricBoundaryArray (w.curve s) g) J =
                      SM.farOnlyOutput (SM.geometricBoundaryArray w.center g) J

SM.wallGapU.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (H : SM.TripleArray n R)

types.SM.wallGapV:
SM.wallGapV.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (H : SM.TripleArray n R)
  (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) (ε : SignType) : R
types.SM.cutWeightedSum_signed_inverse:
SM.cutWeightedSum_signed_inverse.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (f : Fin n → R)
  (H : SM.TripleArray n R) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) (ε : SignType) (hε : ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1)
  (h :
    ∀ (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (k : Fin (π.parts - 1)),
      f (π.interiorPosition k) = -(↑↑ε * H (π.farTriple k)) * ⅟2) :
  SM.cutWeightedSum f (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H) I = SM.wallGapU H I ε
types.SM.cutWeightedSum_neg_signed_inverse:
SM.cutWeightedSum_neg_signed_inverse.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (f : Fin n → R)
  (H : SM.TripleArray n R) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) (ε : SignType) (hε : ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1)
  (h :
    ∀ (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (k : Fin (π.parts - 1)),
      f (π.interiorPosition k) = -(↑↑ε * H (π.farTriple k)) * ⅟2) :
  SM.cutWeightedSum (-f) (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H) I = SM.wallGapV H I ε
types.SM.boundary_left_gap_gate:
SM.boundary_left_gap_gate.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H : SM.TripleArray n R)
  (hH : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H u = SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g u) (p ω : SM.Plane)
  (x y z : ℝ) (hx : SM.boundaryWord P g t.lower = p + x • ω) (hy : SM.boundaryWord P g t.middle = p + y • ω)
  (hz : SM.boundaryWord P g t.upper = p + z • ω) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzx : z ≠ x) (π : SM.IntervalComposition t.leftInterval)
  (k : Fin (π.parts - 1)) :
  t.fixedFarGate H (π.interiorPosition k) = -(↑↑(SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z) * H (π.farTriple k)) * ⅟2
types.SM.boundary_right_gap_gate:
SM.boundary_right_gap_gate.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H : SM.TripleArray n R)
  (hH : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H u = SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g u) (p ω : SM.Plane)
  (x y z : ℝ) (hx : SM.boundaryWord P g t.lower = p + x • ω) (hy : SM.boundaryWord P g t.middle = p + y • ω)
  (hz : SM.boundaryWord P g t.upper = p + z • ω) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x)
  (π : SM.IntervalComposition t.rightInterval) (k : Fin (π.parts - 1)) :
  t.fixedFarGate H (π.interiorPosition k) = -(↑↑(SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z) * H (π.farTriple k)) * ⅟2
types.SM.geometric_gap_sums:
SM.geometric_gap_sums.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H : SM.TripleArray n R)
  (hH : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H u = SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g u) (p ω : SM.Plane)
  (x y z : ℝ) (hx : SM.boundaryWord P g t.lower = p + x • ω) (hy : SM.boundaryWord P g t.middle = p + y • ω)
  (hz : SM.boundaryWord P g t.upper = p + z • ω) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x) :
  SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate H) (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H) t.leftInterval =
      SM.wallGapU H t.leftInterval (SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z) ∧
    SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate H) (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H) t.rightInterval =
        SM.wallGapU H t.rightInterval (SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z) ∧
      SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate (-H)) (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H) t.leftInterval =
          SM.wallGapV H t.leftInterval (SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z) ∧
        SM.cutWeightedSum (t.fixedFarGate (-H)) (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H) t.rightInterval =
          SM.wallGapV H t.rightInterval (SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z)
types.SM.geometric_critical_inverse_response:
SM.geometric_critical_inverse_response.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R)
  (h₁ : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g u)
  (h₂ : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₂ u = SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g u) (p ω : SM.Plane)
  (x y z : ℝ) (hx : SM.boundaryWord P g t.lower = p + x • ω) (hy : SM.boundaryWord P g t.middle = p + y • ω)
  (hz : SM.boundaryWord P g t.upper = p + z • ω) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x) :
  SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₂ t.spanInterval - SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁ t.spanInterval =
    (H₂ t - H₁ t) * ⅟2 *
      (SM.wallGapU H₁ t.leftInterval (SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z) *
        SM.wallGapU H₁ t.rightInterval (SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z))
types.SM.geometric_critical_output_response:
SM.geometric_critical_output_response.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R)
  (h₁ : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g u)
  (h₂ : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₂ u = SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g u) (p ω : SM.Plane)
  (x y z : ℝ) (hx : SM.boundaryWord P g t.lower = p + x • ω) (hy : SM.boundaryWord P g t.middle = p + y • ω)
  (hz : SM.boundaryWord P g t.upper = p + z • ω) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x) :
  SM.farOnlyOutput H₂ t.spanInterval - SM.farOnlyOutput H₁ t.spanInterval =
    (H₂ t - H₁ t) * ⅟2 *
      (SM.wallGapU H₁ t.leftInterval (SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z) *
          SM.wallGapU H₁ t.rightInterval (SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z) +
        SM.wallGapV H₁ t.leftInterval (SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z) *
          SM.wallGapV H₁ t.rightInterval (SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z))
types.SM.WallGerm.full_span_tree_response:
SM.WallGerm.full_span_tree_response.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (w : SM.WallGerm n) (g : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (hZ : SM.pointZeroTriples w.center = {SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet g t})
  (hspan : t.spanInterval = SM.fullBoundaryInterval hn) (p ω : SM.Plane) (x y z : ℝ)
  (hx : SM.boundaryWord w.center g t.lower = p + x • ω) (hy : SM.boundaryWord w.center g t.middle = p + y • ω)
  (hz : SM.boundaryWord w.center g t.upper = p + z • ω) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x) :
  ∃ δ,
    0 < δ ∧
      δ ≤ w.radius ∧
        ∀ (sMinus sPlus : ↑w.Parameter) (hMinus : ↑sMinus < 0) (hPlus : 0 < ↑sPlus),
          |↑sMinus| < δ →
            |↑sPlus| < δ →
              ↑(SM.treeCoefficient (w.curve sPlus) ⋯ g hn) - ↑(SM.treeCoefficient (w.curve sMinus) ⋯ g hn) =
                (SM.geometricBoundaryArray (w.curve sPlus) g t - SM.geometricBoundaryArray (w.curve sMinus) g t) * ⅟2 *
                  (SM.wallGapU (SM.geometricBoundaryArray w.center g) t.leftInterval (SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z) *
                      SM.wallGapU (SM.geometricBoundaryArray w.center g) t.rightInterval (SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z) +
                    SM.wallGapV (SM.geometricBoundaryArray w.center g) t.leftInterval (SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z) *
                      SM.wallGapV (SM.geometricBoundaryArray w.center g) t.rightInterval (SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z))

types.SM.critical_closed_gaps_G1:
SM.critical_closed_gaps_G1 {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
